description: Noita spells (stage 3), read from the player's gun_actions.lua.

name_key.desc: Translation key, e.g. $action_bomb (names are read from the player's Noita at runtime).

name_en.desc: English name, for people reading the sheet.

spawn_level.desc: Noita spawn tiers where it can appear (wands, shops).

projectiles.desc: Projectile files it fires (add_projectile), in order.

trigger_kind.desc: Trigger/timer spells: when the payload is released.

trigger_file.desc: Projectile carrying the payload, or none.

trigger_frames.desc: Timer spells: frames until release (0 otherwise).

draws.desc: Spells drawn right after it into the same shot (modifiers 1, multicasts n).

reload_add.desc: Added to the wand's recharge time, frames.

config_add.desc: Shot config fields it adds to (c.x = c.x + n), e.g. fire_rate_wait, spread_degrees.

config_mul.desc: Shot config fields it multiplies (c.x = c.x * n).

config_set.desc: Shot config fields it sets to a number (c.x = n), e.g. pattern_degrees.

game_effects.desc: Game effect entities added to the shot (comma list), or none.

clamps.desc: Config fields Noita keeps in a range after it (speed_multiplier 0..20, x >= 0).

extra_entities.desc: Entities attached to every projectile of the shot (comma list), or none.

port.desc: data = the columns describe it fully; hand = its Noita function does more (see _sources.port).
